# Beacon

> Beacon is a free, MIT-licensed family command center for wall-mounted displays, and a self-hosted alternative to Skylight Calendar, Hearth Display, and DAKboard. Install it as a one-click Home Assistant add-on, or run it standalone with Docker. It runs in any tablet's browser, or as a signed Android APK sideloaded from GitHub releases (it is not on the Play Store, and there is no iOS build). The dashboard includes a calendar with month and week views, chores, grocery lists, weather, a photo screensaver, custom fonts and themes, Kid Display, kiosk mode, and multiple languages. There is an in-app meal planner with a week grid for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks (it follows Settings → General → Week Starts On) and an editable dashboard Menu card (including on empty days). Meals can use a Beacon recipe. Add ingredients to grocery list writes to the default list or the built-in Shopping List, including Home Assistant to-do lists, not Grocy. The MCP tool beacon_set_meal_plan merges by default; a null or empty name clears one slot, and replace: true restores the old replace-everything behavior. You can still fill the plan from an AnyList sync. Google Photos support works through pasted shared-album links, which the server caches and refreshes every 6 hours; that path relies on an unofficial Google page format. You can also use any Home Assistant media folder as a photo source.

Docs: __SITE_URL__
Source: https://github.com/asachs01/beacon
Latest release: https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases

## Install and setup

- [Getting Started](__SITE_URL__/docs/getting-started/installation/): Install as a Home Assistant add-on, a Docker container, or a development server.
- [Deployment](__SITE_URL__/docs/getting-started/deployment/): Standalone Docker (from [v1.50.1](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.50.1), set `HA_URL` to the base Home Assistant address with no `/api`, plus `HA_TOKEN`; do not set `SUPERVISOR_TOKEN` when standalone), reverse proxy, hardware, kiosk mode, and performance notes. From [v1.54.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.54.0), a device that opens Beacon directly on its port pairs once. See [Pairing a device](__SITE_URL__/docs/getting-started/pairing/).
- [Pairing a device](__SITE_URL__/docs/getting-started/pairing/): From [v1.54.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.54.0). A device that opens Beacon directly on its port (Docker, standalone, or a hand-mapped add-on port) pairs once with the family PIN or a 6-digit code. Opening Beacon from the Home Assistant sidebar, and the Android app's built-in dashboard, do not pair. `HA_BROWSER_TOKEN` is ignored. Automations and `rest_command`s send `Authorization: !secret beacon_token` (the add-on writes it to `secrets.yaml` automatically; on standalone, create one under Settings → Devices → Create access token and add it before restarting Home Assistant). Settings → Devices has Rotate pairing code. From [v1.54.3](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.54.3), the public `runtime-config.js` file contains the family name, theme, and auto dark mode setting; it never contains a token. Update to [v1.54.3](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.54.3) or later. Advisory: [GHSA-rj98-fx8p-896h](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/security/advisories/GHSA-rj98-fx8p-896h).
- [Android app](__SITE_URL__/docs/getting-started/android/): Sideload the signed APK from a GitHub release, verify the checksum, and point it at your Home Assistant URL. Not on the Play Store. No iOS build.
- [Updating and Troubleshooting](__SITE_URL__/docs/getting-started/updating/): How to update (from v1.43.2, Home Assistant pulls a prebuilt image instead of building on the device), roll back, and fix common problems.

## Features

- [Calendar](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/calendar/): Month and week views, recurring events, and drag-to-reschedule.
- [Chores](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/chores/): Assignments, streaks, and a family leaderboard.
- [Chore privileges](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/chore-privileges/): Optional Home Assistant switch when today's chores are done, plus the chore events automations can use.
- [Press-to-talk](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/press-to-talk/): Hold-to-talk on the wall. Runs Home Assistant Assist or Beacon's voice API, completes Beacon chores, and reads today's remaining chores from the family chart.
- [Magic Import](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/magic-import/) ([v1.49.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.49.0)): Paste a school email or other text, or add one photo or PDF (JPEG, PNG, HEIC where the browser can convert it, or PDF; 10 MB). Review draft events and list items, and approve them with the family PIN. Pasted text, and a PDF with real text (read in the browser, first 5 pages), is processed by your Home Assistant conversation agent, or a local parser. If that agent is a cloud service (OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic), Home Assistant sends the text to that provider. Only photos and scanned PDFs (page 1 of a scan) need the Home Assistant AI Task entity you pick in Settings → Display → Magic Import: AI Task entity for photos (Home Assistant 2025.8 or newer). The local parser can't read images, and a failed photo read does not fall back to it. Beacon does not write the file to its own /data; it briefly uploads it to Home Assistant's local media source for the task and deletes it afterward. A cloud AI Task sends the file to that provider. Beacon does not import forwarded email.
- [Grocery](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/grocery/) ([v1.52.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.52.0)): Shopping lists, including Home Assistant and AnyList sources. With the HACS Grocy integration, Magic Import can add items to Grocy's shopping list, and optional expiring-products and low-stock cards (off by default, under Settings → Integrations → Grocy) read `binary_sensor.grocy_expiring_products` and `binary_sensor.grocy_missing_products`. From 1.52.1, with Grocy Integration on, the Grocery screen includes a list named Grocy and check-offs on that list write the shopping-list done flag. The expiring card shows only items due within 3 days.
- [Photos](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/photos/): Local folders, Home Assistant media folders, and cached Google Photos shared albums.
- [Screen Saver](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/screensaver/): Photo screensaver with clock overlay.
- [Night mode](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/night-mode/) ([v1.50.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.50.0)): Off by default under Settings → Display → Night mode, with a schedule (default 9:00 PM to 6:30 AM, overnight ranges work, device local time) and a manual on/off. While it is on, Beacon switches to the Midnight theme, adds a dim layer (default 30%), and can show an optional clock-only screen. A tap removes the dim layer and the clock-only screen for 60 seconds, so the dashboard is back at full brightness, still in the Midnight theme. The dimming is a web overlay; it does not change the device's screen brightness. A finished countdown timer wakes the screen and holds it until the alarm is dismissed. Night mode also runs on the Kid Display and kiosk views when it is turned on.
- [Guest mode](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/guest-mode/) ([v1.51.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.51.0)): Optional guest PIN, empty by default, under Settings → Display → Guest mode. A guest enters with the corner gesture plus that PIN, and a Guest badge stays on the screen. Guests can view the calendar, check off chores, add to the grocery list, and use timers. They can view events but cannot create, edit, or delete them, and they cannot change settings or approve imports. What is hidden is a deny-list: whereabouts features (presence and location) and calendars marked Hide from guests are hidden; meals, photos, music, and the leaderboard stay visible. Guest check-offs on a family member's chore earn points and streaks and show "Checked off by Guest" on chore rows (the Chores screen, and completed chore rows on the dashboard and calendar task lists). Home Assistant to-do items don't get the label. From [v1.52.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.52.0), an unassigned guest check-off is recorded as Guest and earns no points. Guests can earn rewards but cannot redeem them. A session ends with the family PIN, the guest PIN when no family PIN is set, the timeout (default 4 hours), or when the guest PIN is cleared or changed. Leaving kiosk or Kid Display is a separate step. Guest mode is not a security boundary: it only limits what this Beacon screen shows.
- [Home sensors](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/home-sensors/) ([v1.53.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.53.0)): Off by default. Pick entities under Settings → Integrations (each can have a friendly name and icon), then add the card in dashboard edit mode. It is not in the Family, Classic, or Compact layouts. Values update live over the Home Assistant websocket, with no polling. If an entity is unavailable, unknown, or hasn't updated in 3 hours, the card shows "Unavailable", "Unknown", or "No update in 3 h" instead of a stale value. The card shows only the entities you pick, and it excludes cameras. The card is read-only: it does not toggle devices, call services, or show camera feeds. The `/beacon-ws/ha` server connection only passes `get_states`, `state_changed` subscriptions, `unsubscribe_events` for subscriptions it opened, and `ping`; other commands are refused. Hidden from guests and Kid Display. Works with the add-on and standalone (`HA_URL`/`HA_TOKEN`).
- [Meals](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/meals/) ([v1.48.0](https://github.com/asachs01/beacon/releases/tag/v1.48.0)): In-app meal planner with a week grid for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks (follows Settings → General → Week Starts On), an editable Menu card (including on empty days), Beacon recipes, and MCP beacon_set_meal_plan (merges by default; a null or empty name clears one slot; replace: true replaces the whole plan). Add ingredients to grocery list writes to the default list or the built-in Shopping List, including Home Assistant to-do lists, not Grocy.
- [Kid Display Mode](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/kid-display/): A simplified view for children.
- [Dashboard](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/dashboard/): The home screen layout.
- [Family Members](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/family/): People, colors, and calendars.
- [Music](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/music/): Home Assistant media player controls.
- [Timer](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/timer/): Named timers.
- [Notifications](__SITE_URL__/docs/features/notifications/): Notification settings.
